title: That door is taken
summary: Port 8093 is already in use. Read the error, clean up, and use another door.

tasks.title: `squatter` is still running on port 8093
tasks.hint: Leave `squatter` alone. If you stopped it by accident: `docker start squatter`.

tasks.title: `shop` (nginx) opens on `http://localhost:8094`
tasks.hint: Port 8093 is taken, so use the next one: `-p 8094:80`. If Docker says the name `shop` is already in use, the failed try left a container behind: remove it with `docker rm shop`, then run again.
